summary: Priya (Northwind SaaS) ran discovery with Hanna and Marc from Alpine Outdoor Co. Twelve agents share one Gmail inbox and get about 3,000 emails a week at peak; they want a first reply within four hours. Budget is decided in January, with a go-live goal before the March spring sale.

follow_up.subject: Alpine Outdoor × Northwind: next steps from today
follow_up.body:
Hi Hanna and Marc,

Thanks for the time today. A quick recap of what we agreed:

- I'll send pricing for twelve seats and the Shopify integration one-pager by Thursday.
- I'll book a demo with our solutions engineer for next week, using sample tickets like yours.
- Marc will share last November's ticket volumes so we can size it.

You mentioned a first reply within four hours at peak and going live before the spring sale in March. I'll keep both in mind for the proposal.

Best,
Priya
